arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Social Security Administration outlay data (in millions)
data = [754179, 784194, 821144, 867394, 905769, 944143, 976783, 1000812, 1039902, 1101833]

n = len(data)
print(f"Data points: {n}")
print(f"Data: {data}")

# Calculate mean
mean = sum(data) / n
print(f"\nMean: {mean}")

# Calculate population variance and population standard deviation
# Population variance = sum((x - mean)^2) / n
squared_diffs = [(x - mean) ** 2 for x in data]
variance = sum(squared_diffs) / n
pop_std = math.sqrt(variance)

print(f"Population Variance: {variance}")
print(f"Population Standard Deviation: {pop_std}")

# Calculate coefficient of variation (as percentage)
cv = (pop_std / mean) * 100

print(f"\nCoefficient of Variation: {cv}%")

# Round to nearest hundredths
cv_rounded = round(cv, 2)
print(f"Coefficient of Variation (rounded): {cv_rounded}%")
EOF
